"""Audit paired training bindings and scalar replay without any neural forward."""

import argparse
import json
import math
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save


def main(root):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    previous = Path(plan["previous"])
    original = read(plan["original_trace"]["path"])
    result = read(root / "train-result-v1.json")
    cache = read(root / "cache-result-v1.json")
    cache_rows = [json.loads(s) for s in (root / "cache-trace-v1.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    rows = [json.loads(s) for s in (root / "train-trace-v1.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows) == len(cache_rows) == len(original["trace"]) == 1000
    assert rows == result["trace"] and cache_rows == cache["batches"]
    differences = {k: [] for k in rows[0]["arms"]["scalar-control"]}
    for step, (row, cached, old) in enumerate(zip(rows, cache_rows, original["trace"]), 1):
        assert row["step"] == cached["step"] == old["step"] == step
        assert cached["inputs"] == old["inputs"] and cached["metadata"] == old["metadata"]
        assert row["batch"] == cached["arrays"]
        assert row["domain"] == cached["metadata"]["domain"]
        assert cached["adopted_old_prefix"] == (step <= 10)
        assert set(row["arms"]) == {"scalar-control", "phase-matrix"}
        assert row["arms"]["scalar-control"]["lr"] == row["arms"]["phase-matrix"]["lr"]
        for arm in row["arms"].values():
            assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in arm.values())
        for key, value in row["arms"]["scalar-control"].items():
            differences[key].append(abs(value - old[key]))
            assert math.isclose(value, old[key], rel_tol=2e-6, abs_tol=1e-7)
    for key in ("spectral", "gradient_norm", "lr"):
        assert max(differences[key]) == 0
    assert cache["parent_before"] == cache["parent_after"]
    assert cache["DINO_before"] == cache["DINO_after"]
    assert result["counts"] == result["updates"] == {"scalar-control": 1000, "phase-matrix": 1000}
    assert result["initial_outputs_exact_parent"] and result["steps"] == 1000
    assert result["new_parent_DINO_forwards"] == result["new_noise_draws"] == 0
    assert ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"]) == result["checkpoint"]
    state = torch.load(result["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    old_state = torch.load(original["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    assert state["step"] == state["horizon"] == 1000
    for arm, count in (("scalar-control", 30402), ("phase-matrix", 31409)):
        assert len(state["models"][arm]) == len(state["emas"][arm]) == 12
        assert sum(t.numel() for t in state["models"][arm].values()) == count
        for group in (state["models"][arm], state["emas"][arm]):
            assert all(torch.isfinite(t).all() for t in group.values())
        adam = state["optimizers"][arm]["state"]
        assert len(adam) == 12
        for values in adam.values():
            assert int(values["step"]) == 1000
            assert all(not torch.is_tensor(t) or torch.isfinite(t).all() for t in values.values())
        gradients = result["parameter_maximum_gradients"][arm]
        assert len(gradients) == 12 and all(math.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in gradients.values())
    for group, old_key in (("models", "model"), ("emas", "ema")):
        assert state[group]["scalar-control"].keys() == old_state[old_key].keys()
        assert all(
            torch.equal(t, old_state[old_key][k]) for k, t in state[group]["scalar-control"].items()
        )
    review = read(root / "review-result-v1.json")
    old_mixed = read(previous / "mixed-quiet-v1/result-v1.json")
    exact = 0
    for endpoint in ("raw", "EMA"):
        old_label = f"{endpoint}-step1000"
        new_label = f"scalar-control-{old_label}"
        old_collection = read(previous / f"review-v1/{old_label}/collection-v1.json")
        archived = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in old_collection["observations"]}
        archived.update(
            {r["id"]: r["prediction"] for r in old_mixed["rows"] if r["method"] == old_label}
        )
        collection = read(review["collections"][new_label]["path"])
        assert len(archived) == len(collection["observations"]) == 798
        for observation in collection["observations"]:
            new, old = observation["prediction"], archived[observation["id"]]
            assert ref(new["path"]) == new and ref(old["path"]) == old
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.load(new["path"]), np.load(old["path"]))
            exact += 1
    save(
        root / "independent-training-audit-v2.json",
        {
            "status": "passed-paired-bindings-finite-states-and-complete-scalar-replay",
            "auditor": ref(__file__),
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "training_result": ref(root / "train-result-v1.json"),
            "training_trace": ref(root / "train-trace-v1.jsonl"),
            "cache_result": ref(root / "cache-result-v1.json"),
            "cache_trace": ref(root / "cache-trace-v1.jsonl"),
            "original_training": plan["original_trace"],
            "review": ref(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
            "checkpoint": result["checkpoint"],
            "matched_steps_per_arm": 1000,
            "cached_observations": 4000,
            "all_input_target_fingerprints_and_metadata_match_original": True,
            "scalar_trace_differences": {
                k: {"nonexact_steps": sum(v > 0 for v in values), "maximum_abs": max(values)}
                for k, values in differences.items()
            },
            "scalar_reported_loss_comparison_tolerance": {"rtol": 2e-6, "atol": 1e-7},
            "scalar_raw_and_EMA_weights_exact_original": True,
            "scalar_predictions_exact_original": exact,
            "finite_Adam_states_at1000_per_arm": 12,
            "all12_tensors_nonzero_finite_gradient_each_arm": True,
            "batch_domains": dict(Counter(r["domain"] for r in rows)),
            "parent_and_DINO_hashes_unchanged_during_cache": True,
            "new_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "prior_audit_failure": ref(root / "training-audit-failure-v1.json"),
            "scope": "Posthoc array/state audit. The initial bitexact assertion on reported scalar loss reductions was too strong and is preserved with its source. Pixel/gradient/total loss reductions differ by at most1.91e-6; spectral loss, gradient norm, LR, both final weight sets and all1596 endpoint predictions reproduce V147 exactly. No training/input change. This does not establish matrix quality or independent validation.",
        },
    )
    print("PASS:1000 matched steps,24 finite Adam states,1596 exact scalar replay predictions")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

"""Publish byte-exact V148 receipts and native images after actual viewing."""

import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

REPO = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT = REPO / '.cache/quality-20261103/V148-phase-matrix-v1'


def main():
    plan = read(ROOT / 'plan-v1.json')
    guard(plan)
    figures = read(ROOT / 'figures-v1.json')
    viewed = read(ROOT / 'native-viewing-v1.json')
    assert viewed['indices_covered'] == list(range(58)) and viewed['sheets_viewed'] == 15
    assert read(ROOT / 'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')['status'] == 'pass'
    assert read(ROOT / 'independent-training-audit-v2.json')['scalar_predictions_exact_original'] == 1596
    assert read(ROOT / 'execution-completion-v1.json')['recorded_owner_count'] == 11
    reports = REPO / 'docs/results/v148-phase-matrix-v1'
    images = REPO / 'docs/images/v148-phase-matrix-v1'
    reports.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    images.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    copies = {}
    sources = {
        'training-audit.json': ROOT / 'independent-training-audit-v2.json',
        'training-audit-failure-v1.json': ROOT / 'training-audit-failure-v1.json',
        'review-result.json': ROOT / 'review-result-v1.json',
        'scores.json': ROOT / 'scores-v1.json',
        'metric-audit.json': ROOT / 'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json',
        'figures.json': ROOT / 'figures-v1.json',
        'native-viewing.json': ROOT / 'native-viewing-v1.json',
        'execution-completion.json': ROOT / 'execution-completion-v1.json',
        'training-completion.json': ROOT / 'status-v1.json',
        'postprocess-completion.json': ROOT / 'postprocess-status-v1.json',
    }
    review = read(ROOT / 'review-result-v1.json')
    for label, binding in review['collections'].items():
        sources[f'{label}-collection.json'] = Path(binding['path'])
    for name, source in sources.items():
        destination = reports / name
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        original, public = ref(source), ref(destination)
        assert original['sha256'] == public['sha256']
        copies[name] = {'original': original, 'public': public}
    records = []
    for record in figures['images']:
        source = Path(record['image']['path'])
        assert ref(source) == record['image']
        destination = images / source.name
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        assert ref(destination)['sha256'] == record['image']['sha256']
        records.append({**record, 'original_image': record['image'], 'image': ref(destination)})
    save(images / 'manifest-v1.json', {
        'status': 'published-byte-exact-native-figures-after-actual-viewing',
        'original_manifest': ref(ROOT / 'figures-v1.json'),
        'native_viewing': ref(ROOT / 'native-viewing-v1.json'),
        'checkpoints': figures['checkpoints'],
        'parent': figures['parent'],
        'images': records,
        'primary_figures': 58,
        'triplets': sum('triplet_source_board' in r for r in records),
        'no_resize': True,
        'independently_checked_RGB_channels': figures['all_RGB_channels_checked'],
        'scope': 'Each160x160 crop has original source/ROI, noise conditioning, exposure, anchor and contrast. All four endpoints use identical inputs/transforms. RealISO100/AHD/JPEG references are qualitative, not exactGT; cameraJPEGs remain native unboosted sRGB8. Triplets repeat existing pixels.'
    })
    training = read(ROOT / 'train-result-v1.json')
    save(reports / 'training-index.json', {
        'original_result': ref(ROOT / 'train-result-v1.json'),
        'original_trace': ref(ROOT / 'train-trace-v1.jsonl'),
        'checkpoint': training['checkpoint'],
        'counts': training['counts'],
        'updates': training['updates'],
        'parameter_maximum_gradients': training['parameter_maximum_gradients'],
        'trace': training['trace'],
        'scope': 'Derived compact index, preserving full original training result and JSONL bytes. Each row binds the identical cached batch consumed by both fresh heads.'
    })
    prep = read(REPO / 'docs/results/v148-phase-matrix-preparation-v1.json')
    source_paths = [
        REPO / 'scripts/audit_phase_matrix_training.py',
        ROOT / 'training-audit-failure-source-v1.py',
        Path(__file__),
    ]
    save(reports / 'source-bundle.json', {
        'preparation': ref(REPO / 'docs/results/v148-phase-matrix-preparation-v1.json'),
        'frozen_training_and_review_source_bundle': prep['source_bundle'],
        'neural_source_hashes_at_review': plan['source_modules'],
        'additional_sources': [dict(ref(p), text=p.read_text()) for p in source_paths],
        'scope': 'The preparation bundle binds all84 frozen neural files and training/review/report sources. This adds the posthoc training auditor, its preserved failed v1 source and this publisher. No scientific source, input or endpoint was changed after the frozen matched design.'
    })
    scores = read(ROOT / 'scores-v1.json')
    summary = scores['summary']
    save(reports / 'summary.json', {
        'original_scores': ref(ROOT / 'scores-v1.json'),
        'groups': summary,
        'scope': 'Mean per-observation errors from retained cases. Four CFA placements of a recipe are related observations, not independent scenes. Historical fresh cohort labels denote original construction, not newly drawn V148 validation.'
    })
    save(REPO / 'docs/results/v148-phase-matrix-final-v1.json', {
        'status': 'completed-matched-phase-trial-no-useful-weak-detail-quiet-region-gain',
        'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(),
        'copies': copies,
        'preparation': ref(REPO / 'docs/results/v148-phase-matrix-preparation-v1.json'),
        'source_bundle': ref(reports / 'source-bundle.json'),
        'training_index': ref(reports / 'training-index.json'),
        'summary': ref(reports / 'summary.json'),
        'figures': ref(images / 'manifest-v1.json'),
        'checkpoint': training['checkpoint'],
        'endpoints': figures['checkpoints'],
        'steps_per_arm': 1000,
        'observations_per_endpoint': 798,
        'quality_component_forwards': 3192,
        'engineering_component_forwards': 84,
        'discarded_smoke_component_forwards': 20,
        'training_component_forwards': 2000,
        'total_tracked_component_forwards': 5296,
        'new_parent_DINO_forwards': 990,
        'replayed_noise_observation_constructions': 3960,
        'adopted_training_observations': 40,
        'new_independent_observations': 0,
        'native_primary_figures': 58,
        'native_sheets_actually_viewed': 15,
        'independently_checked_RGB_channels': figures['all_RGB_channels_checked'],
        'scalar_predictions_exact_original': 1596,
        'recorded_terminal_owners': 11,
        'scope': 'Both raw/EMA endpoints from each matched fresh arm, no early endpoint selection. Matrix reduces strong-edge whole-image error and slightly lowers some scalar regressions, but mesh response, photographic band errors and exact quiet regions do not improve. Full512 noisy-flat errors remain worse than parent; a small native256 ISO12800 gain is recorded separately. No ordinary inference integration. Overall fine-detail/clean-sky goal remains active.'
    })
    print('Published14 byte-exact receipts,58 native PNGs,16 triplets and compact training/source indexes')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
